quota._note: Workstream B routing: a SIMPLE step (direct answer) may move to the next model after maxWaitMs of per-minute cooling (C-08/N-15). A COMPLEX step stays on the pinned capable model and waits up to complexMaxWaitMs; then the other capable provider (Gemini, if allowed); then a per-minute reset up to tpmResetMaxWaitMs; only then the weak model, per OperatorPolicy.weakModelPolicy.

weak._note: Degraded mode: at most this many steps of a complex task on the weak model; never a recovery (effort=high) step.

network._note: N-10 (overnight hybrid pass): 'online' means the internet ANSWERS. LinkHealth opens a circuit after a network failure that took >= stall.slowFailMs, two in a row, or a failed probe; while open the router, ASR and web search stay on the phone. A success or a passing probe closes it; after stall.openMs it half-opens. h2PingSec: HTTP/2 PINGs fail a dead connection in ~2 intervals instead of the 35 s call timeout (0 = off). watchdogMs: a cloud call silent this long triggers a probe; a failed probe abandons the call. providerCoolMs: a provider that timed out goes to the back of the chain this long.

localPlan._note: N-09: a compound request whose every clause is a LocalBrain intent runs on the phone, clause by clause.

offlineQueue._note: N-09: offline, a self-contained knowledge question can be kept (only if the user says yes) and answered when the internet is back. Memory only.

phrases.answer: The internet is back. Earlier you asked: {goal}. {answer}

localModel._note: The on-device planner (LocalModelBrain + LiteRtLlm, 1 Nov 2026): a downloaded .litertlm in the app's files (never the APK), the benchmark's conversation prompt, one conversation per task. OFF until a model file is present; 'first' = local before the cloud. constrainReply: grammar-constrained decoding, OFF (it emptied the arguments, Kaggle 1 Nov). freshEnginePerTask: a new engine per task, ON while LiteRT-LM #3165 (recurrent-state leak between conversations on Qwen3.5) is open.

search._note: web_search ladder, first usable provider with an answer wins. 'space' = OUR Hugging Face Space (POST /web/ask, free, plans + searches + reads pages + answers with a small model; only the query text is sent). Skipped when disabled, offline, or cooling after a failure/429. Move 'space' later in the list, or set space.enabled=false, to prefer Groq. space.url empty = the SPEECH_SPACE_URL host from local.properties; space.mode 'answer' (research + model) or 'results' (search only).

answers._note: H-11: recent answers to general-knowledge questions (memory only). Fresh = repeated as-is; stale = offered offline with its age.
